chapter.verse: Tu-a kong pai ding pen a thumveina ahi hi. Thu kici khempeuh teci nihlethum ii genkhiat kam tawh kip ding hi.

Kong hawh a nihveina lai-a kong om sungin kong genkholhsa mah bangin tu-in zong pumpi tawh kong om loh hangin kong paikik zenzen leh tuma-a mawhna bawlte leh midangte khempeuh hong koihkhong lo ding cih kong genkhol hi.
A hang pen note' vai ah thanem lo-in note' lakah a thahat ahi Khris, kei' tungtawnin thugen takpi hiam cih lahcianna na zong uh hi.

Amah pen thanemna tawh kikhailum himah taleh Pasian' vangliatna hangin hingkik hi. Kote zong ama' sungah ka thanem uh a, ahi zongin note' vai ka sepna uhah Pasian' vangliatna hangin amah tawh ka nungta ding uh hi.

Upna sungah om omlo cih na kitheih nadingun noleno ki-entel un. Noleno ki-sittel un. Na sung uhah Jesu Khris om ahihlam noleno kitel lo na hi uh hiam?—kisittelna ah awk na hihkei buang uhleh, cihna hi.
Kisittelna ah awk lo ka hihlam uh hong thei dingin kong lamen uh hi.

Ahi zongin ka khialh loh nadingun Pasian' kiangah thu ka ngen uh hi. Tua pen kisittelna a nawk khinzo kong bat nading uh hilo-in kisittelna a nawk zolo tawh ka kibatkhak uhleh zong a hoihin na gamtat ding uh deihna ahi hi.
A hang pen thumaan thutak lehngatin bangmah ka sem thei kei uh a, thumaan thutak' ading bek ka sem thei uh hi.
Tua hi a, kote thanemin note na thakhauh uh ciangin ka lungdam uh hi. Note cingtaaktak a tehcing na hih ding uh kote' thungetna ahi hi.

Tua thu hangin kei kong tun ciangin phelkhiat nading ahilo, lambeh nadinga Topa' hong piak ahi, keima' thuneihna a guhgamin ka zatkhak loh ding deihna tawh pumpi i kigamlat laitak hih thute hong gelh ka hi hi.
A nunungpen ah sanggamte aw, lungdam un. Kipuahphat ding tum unla, khatlekhat kidinpihin khatlekhat kithutuakin na kilem un. Tua hileh itna leh nopna lemna Pasian in note hong ompih ding hi.
Siangtho kinapna tawh khatlekhat na kihopih un. Mi siangtho khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi.
Topa Jesu Khris' hong hehpihna, Pasian' hong itna leh Kha Siangtho' hong kikholhpihna note khempeuh tawh hong om ta hen.
